purpose: Illustrate resource depletion, dependency cascades, and human-governed escalation across facilities, healthcare supply, and broadcast/OTT operations. Not for operational use.

safety_boundary.rule: Treat every value as illustrative. Verify live measurements, source provenance, units, timestamps, uncertainty, and responsible-owner approval before operational decisions.

scenarios.title: Extended grid outage with diesel shortage
scenarios.trigger: Grid outage persists while diesel replenishment is delayed or uncertain.
scenarios.resource: Usable generator fuel and UPS endurance

illustrative_observations.claim: Fuel estimate indicates approximately 4 hours of runtime at current load
Restoration estimate is 7–10 hours and not confirmed
Server rooms, cooling, fire protection and network equipment have critical dependencies

scenarios.cascade_hypothesis: Backup endurance may expire before grid restoration or fuel replenishment, causing loss of multiple dependent services.

time_to_impact.reason: Must be calculated from fresh fuel, load, generator limits, UPS state and uncertainty; the 4-hour observation is illustrative only.

counter_evidence_to_check: Confirm usable fuel level and consumption trend
Confirm delivery and usable fuel quantity with supplier
Validate which loads and cooling systems share each power path
recommended_human_response: Escalate to the facility incident lead before the estimated endurance margin is breached
Validate a controlled load-shedding sequence that preserves life-safety and critical IT dependencies
Coordinate fuel supply and recovery updates across affected tenants
scenarios.reason: All observations are synthetic and unverified; operational switching requires authorised facilities personnel.

scenarios.title: Oxygen replenishment may arrive after usable supply is depleted
scenarios.trigger: Hospital demand is elevated while a delivery is delayed or not independently confirmed.
scenarios.resource: Usable medical oxygen inventory and replenishment capacity

illustrative_observations.claim: Illustrative usable supply estimate is 5 hours at the current measured consumption rate
Expected replenishment is in 7 hours but delivery is not confirmed
Demand may change and clinical reserve thresholds must be supplied by authorised hospital teams

scenarios.cascade_hypothesis: If current consumption persists and delivery is late, the hospital may approach a critical supply threshold before replenishment.

time_to_impact.reason: Requires validated usable capacity, pressure/flow data, changing demand, reserve policy and delivery confidence; never use this fixture as a clinical estimate.

counter_evidence_to_check: Verify telemetry, usable capacity and consumption trend
Confirm supplier dispatch, vehicle location and realistic arrival time
Check approved alternative supply and transfer arrangements
Obtain the hospital's current reserve and escalation thresholds
recommended_human_response: Immediately alert the authorised hospital incident lead and oxygen/facilities team when the validated margin is threatened
Coordinate emergency replenishment and approved contingency supply
Keep clinical triage and patient-care decisions with authorised clinicians under established protocols
scenarios.reason: Synthetic and unverified evidence; no automated clinical triage, patient ranking, oxygen allocation or treatment withdrawal.

scenarios.title: Thunderstorm coincides with deteriorating contribution-feed quality
scenarios.trigger: Severe weather forecast overlaps a satellite reception or exposed contribution-link site.
scenarios.resource: Signal margin, feed redundancy and backup power

illustrative_observations.claim: Storm risk forecast near the reception site
Continuity errors are increasing on one feed
Alternate feed availability and failover readiness are not yet confirmed

scenarios.cascade_hypothesis: Weather-related feed degradation may progress into channel loss and downstream service interruption if the alternate path is unavailable.

time_to_impact.reason: No fixed time is inferred from weather alone; estimate only after correlating live signal trends, error rates, redundancy and service dependencies.

counter_evidence_to_check: Validate weather-site match and feed telemetry timestamps
Check whether errors originate in reception, encoding, packaging, DRM/CAS or distribution
Verify alternate feed and failover status
Map affected services and downstream regions
recommended_human_response: Alert broadcast operations and validate the fault domain
Prepare an authorised switch to a verified alternate feed if the evidence supports it
Monitor downstream channel, packaging and viewer-impact indicators
scenarios.reason: Correlated signals are not yet independently verified; no automatic feed switching is authorised by this fixture.
